scenes: Three days before taking office, Donald Trump launched his own crypto coin.
Two days later, it hits seventy-three dollars. Fourteen and a half billion in total.
But eighty percent of the coins belong to Trump-linked companies.
By March, the price is down more than eighty percent.
Then an offer: the top two hundred twenty holders get dinner with the President.
Meme coin, or the most expensive dinner ticket ever?
